project_type: Laravel 13 server-rendered Blade business permit system (Municipality of Bansud). No SPA, no Livewire/Inertia/Vite. Light government-portal theme on body.has-sidebar for the authenticated applicant portal; homepage/login/register/auth pages are a separate DARK theme and must NOT be edited.
build_system: Composer (no composer install needed — deps present). No new Composer packages. No build step for Blade views; static CSS in public/css/app.css. Carbon 3.14.2 bundled (nesbot/carbon) — diffInDays() returns a SIGNED FLOAT, so floor+cast to int for day counts.
test_framework: PHPUnit via php artisan test (tests/Feature/*). Shared helper trait Tests\Support\MakesDomainData provides makeApplicant/makeBplo/makeTreasurer/makeApplication($owner,$status,$overrides)/makePendingPayment/makePermit($app,$status,$validUntil). Tests use RefreshDatabase and seed RequirementTypeSeeder where needed.
build_command: php artisan route:list (to confirm routes resolve); php artisan tinker --execute="..." for config checks
verification_instructions: ALWAYS run every artisan/composer/test command with cwd "c:\\Users\\HP\\BUSINESS PERMIT_SYSTEM\\app" (the app subfolder IS the Laravel root; the parent path contains a SPACE — quote every path). Protect the baseline: php artisan test must stay GREEN at >= 154 passed / 519 assertions plus any new tests. After backend changes specifically re-run: php artisan test tests/Feature/Applicant/ApplicationFlowTest.php tests/Feature/Roles/MassAssignmentTest.php tests/Feature/Payment/ManualPaymentTest.php. Clean up temporary artifacts after verification.
environment_constraints: Windows / PowerShell. Parent path 'c:\\Users\\HP\\BUSINESS PERMIT_SYSTEM' contains a SPACE — quote all paths; relative paths in commands must resolve against the app/ Laravel root, never the parent. SQLite dev DB. Timezone Asia/Manila. Payment mode manual (GCash number 09670829993 / name Aiza Domingo come from .env via config, never hard-code).
contribution_requirements: app/AGENTS.md carries only Laravel-Boost bootstrap guidance; PHP/Composer already present and deps installed, so NO boost install is needed — proceed directly. Follow existing applicant-portal conventions: controllers under App\Http\Controllers\Applicant, non-Auth FormRequests under App\Http\Requests, views under resources/views/applicant extending layouts.app.
key_patterns: Role is NEVER mass-assignable: follow Auth\RegisterController — $user->fill([only name,email,password,contact_number,address,is_active]) then set role separately; role/is_active never in a FormRequest. Business user_id set via $business->user()->associate($user), never mass-assigned. Nine Application::STATUS_* constants only; render status via <x-status-badge>. Correction/rejection reasons from ApplicationRemark (type literal 'CORRECTION'/'REJECTION', column body) + ApplicationStatusHistory.note. Fees only via FeeComputationService::computeFor() or a persisted Payment row, never hard-coded, never before APPROVED_FOR_PAYMENT. Payment verified by TREASURER (process-tracker step table STATUS_PAYMENT_PENDING => 'Treasurer'), never BPLO. Password rule pinned to Auth\RegisterRequest: Password::min(8)->mixedCase()->numbers(); contact_number rule ['nullable','string','max:32'] (NOT the strict ApplicationRequest regex). Email uniqueness via Rule::unique('users','email')->ignore($this->user()->id). User model casts password => 'hashed' (assignment hashes). _form-fields partial binds Application-shaped field names, so Business prefill must be remapped (name->business_name, address->business_address, nature->business_nature; barangay/ownership_type/dti_sec_type/dti_sec_number same-named; number_of_employees ?? 0).

directory_structure: app/ is the Laravel root. app/Http/Controllers/Applicant/ holds applicant controllers; app/Http/Requests/ holds non-Auth FormRequests (ApplicationRequest etc.), app/Http/Requests/Auth/ holds RegisterRequest. app/Models/ holds Eloquent models. app/Services/ holds ApplicationWorkflowService, FeeComputationService, PaymentService, PermitService, TrackingNumberService. app/Support/ holds PaymentMethods, FeeBreakdown. config/permit.php holds all domain config. routes/web.php groups routes by role middleware. resources/views/applicant/ holds applicant views; resources/views/components/ holds Blade components; resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php is the light authenticated shell. tests/Feature/<Area>/ holds feature tests; tests/Support/MakesDomainData.php is the shared trait. .agents/tasks/ holds planning artifacts (NOT part of the app).
